vr1102e.title: Sony MDS-PC2 MD Deck MiniDisc Recorder Silver with Remote Control Working
vr1102e.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vr1102e.details: Sony MDS-PC2 MiniDisc deck in silver, a compact 15 cm wide MD recorder with analog and optical digital inputs and a headphone jack on the front. Condition: there are light scuffs and marks from normal use, as shown in the photos. The unit was cleaned and wiped with alcohol. Operation was checked and the display powers on normally. Included, as shown in the photos: the MDS-PC2 deck, a remote control and the attached power cable. No disc, box or manual is included. This is a Japanese-market model built for 100V AC with a Japanese 2-pin plug, so please check the voltage and plug in your country before purchasing. Please see the photos for the exact condition.
